capture_method.bytes_definition: SHA-256 is computed over the exact body file saved by curl, without parsing, newline normalization, or reserialization. Header files contain curl -D output; their SHA-256 is separately recorded. Redirects are followed; curl metadata records final URL, status, content type, and downloaded byte count.
capture_method.verification: Recompute SHA-256 directly from each .body and .headers file. No search snippet or browser-rendered text is treated as a raw-response snapshot.
capture_method.network_note: github.com timed out from the command-line retrieval path for the two libpng GHSA pages; api.github.com/advisories for those GHSA identifiers returned HTTP 404. Browser-readable primary text was used only to transcribe scope and is not claimed as hashed response bytes.
